metadata.title: NCache.Azure
metadata.description: The NCache Azure PowerShell Module simplifies managing NCache environments in Microsoft Azure. It lets you deploy, configure, license, monitor, and test distributed caches and clients through an easy-to-use set of PowerShell cmdlets
